---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change to the format, a new profile, or a reference implementation improvement
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What are you trying to do?**
Describe the use case, not just the proposed solution — this matters most for
changes to `SPEC.md`, since it affects every FPF reader and writer.

**Proposed change**
What would need to change: a new optional field, a new country profile, a new
reference implementation, a behavior change in an existing one, etc.

**Backward compatibility**
Would existing FPF 1.0 documents remain valid and correctly interpreted after this
change? If not, explain why a version bump would be needed instead.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other way to achieve the same goal without changing the format.
